description: This file defines the ScreenConnectorCtrl class, which manages synchronization and mode control for screen connector threads in a concurrent environment, specifically for Android and confirmation UI modes.

classes.name: ScreenConnectorCtrl
classes.description: A class that orchestrates concurrent execution of threads related to screen connection, managing modes and synchronization.

methods.name: WaitAndroidMode
methods.description: Blocks the calling thread until the mode is set to kAndroidMode, using a combination of atomic check and condition variable wait for efficiency.

methods.name: SetMode
methods.description: Sets the current mode (Android or Confirmation UI) and notifies waiting threads if mode is set to Android.

methods.name: GetMode
methods.description: Returns the current mode in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: SemWait
methods.description: Blocks until the semaphore is signaled, used for thread synchronization.

methods.name: SemPost
methods.description: Signals the semaphore, potentially waking waiting threads.
